description.description: A close-up photograph of journalist Jemele Hill smiling, with a screenshot of her tweet overlaid on the bottom center of the image. The tweet discusses the Atlanta Falcons' coaching hire and the city's preference for Deion Sanders.
description.ocrText: ES PA SAN Jemele Hill @jemelehill Harry Douglas was absolutely right. None of the Falcons fans I know like the Stefanski hire. He had a losing record in Cleveland and they didn't like how he handled the Shedeur Sanders situation. They LOVE Deion in the ATL. It's a Black city, with one of the Blackest fan bases in the NFL, and they have a Black QB on their roster - so a lot of ATL fans are side-eyeing this hire. Stefanski isn't going to get a honeymoon there.
